'''Shihon''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Shihon system/Legends|Shihon system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked the world to the [[Ool system/Legends|Ool]] and [[Oyokal system/Legends|Oyokal systems]]. The planet's surface featured several [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="TEA" />

Shihon was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to several animal [[Species/Legends|species]], all of which had [[Bone/Legends|boneless]] body structures. Two examples of Shihon's fauna were bulbous [[gas-bag]]s that filled the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] and [[City/Legends|city]]-sized [[Jellyfish/Legends|jellies]] that were prevalent in the oceans.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shihon was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square E-8.<ref name="TEA" />
